effective_scope: Supplemental completion classification/proof for UR0b. Preserve original protocol, metric schema, product mutation/presentation semantics and old results. This corrects the all-raw population predicate only.

population.universe: Every raw record with kind=12,tag=29,values[0]=1 in the immutable trace. Do not truncate by metric window, generation or operation before accounting.
population.partition: Each actual accepted record sequence belongs to exactly one class and remains referenced in the proof. Conflicting/duplicate identity is UNRESOLVED and blocks; rejected/raw callback-entry records remain separately retained.
equations: qualified_decoded_count = qualified_committed_count (legacy field retains its mutation-only meaning)
population.no_default_ids: A real recorded zero is a value; absent identity is not zero. Initialization operation_id is null with explicit NOT_APPLICABLE meaning, never a fabricated all-zero Operation.

common_native_chain.required: Retain the existing full owner/runtime/lifetime/attachment/document/epoch/resource/view and actual frame/Scene/camera/surface/metrics/work stamps, unique successful provider job/basis and draw→provider→capture→accepted-completion chronology. Compare exact lossless native values. Keep all preparation attempts. A GPU/resource epoch never substitutes for a document/resource generation.
fail_closed: critical loss or existing identity error

initialization.label: INITIALIZATION
initialization.scope: Fresh empty document created through the frozen UR0b consumer init() createRuntime call, without snapshot/resource document import. This v1 amendment does not qualify arbitrary restored generation-zero documents.

recording_basis.check_against: The archived run.source_before.files identities and exact immutable input binding; do not replace them with current decoder source or a caller true flag.

required_all: Common native chain is complete and uniquely matched; initial draw/capture have actual semanticGeneration=0, sceneGeneration=0, sceneRevision=0 and commitRevision=0. These zeros alone never qualify a frame.

Archived run.init.state is a real public createRuntime return state: documentId matches native document; generation=0, objects=0, lastCommit.ordinal=0. The archived public lastCommit all-zero Operation sentinel means absence only; it is not an Operation identity.

Public init.state.target attachmentEpoch, viewId and runtimeEpoch match native attachment/view/document epoch. Public target.runtimeEpoch is document epoch, not runtime instance or lastCommit.runtimeEpoch; lifetime/runtime instance must come from the actual native chain.
The frozen fresh-empty init harness/source identities are proven. Missing public initial state, a nonempty/restored document, a different source profile or unproved creation context stays UNRESOLVED.

No matching-owner semantic commit/Scene publication exists before the initialization draw/capture. Any observed matching-owner commit at or before capture, nonzero commit basis or contradictory generation defeats INITIALIZATION. Preserve completion identity even if an independently accepted old initialization callback occurs later; never let it confirm later commit state.
Keep every source seq and the public-state/source/input hash references in initialization_chains; do not fabricate an Operation or Scene publication event.
initialization.public_measurement_before: Not mandatory: separate correctness workers may lack it. When present it is a later observation, not automatically the initial anchor; a setup fixture may already have committed by that time. It may corroborate fresh initial state but cannot replace a missing run.init.state.
initialization.metric_treatment: Do not create a canonical interaction receipt or Up/Commit→Canonical timing for initialization. Record its lifecycle completion separately in proof/provenance. Existing job terminal state may become Completed only by its own actual accepted completion, leaving operation absent and without attributing it to a stroke/erase.
initialization.outside_scope: Other lifecycle/restored frames remain UNRESOLVED unless supported by a later explicit basis. Do not infer initialization from operation=null or generation=0 alone.

committed.label: COMMITTED
committed.requirements: All existing Operation/commit→Scene→draw/provider/capture→accepted completion identity, successful-attempt, clock and metric-receipt requirements remain. Initialization handling cannot satisfy missing post-commit proof.
committed.positive_gate: require_positive=True always requires qualified_committed_count>0, even when all accepted frames are valid INITIALIZATION. Native-only scope can omit metric receipts but cannot omit the committed native chain.
committed.metrics: Only COMMITTED contributes to decoded.qualified_completions (or an explicitly named equivalent committed list) and mutation canonical_receipts. Preserve existing measured values and receipt basis exactly.

fields.qualified_initialization_count: initialization chains satisfying the full basis
fields.qualified_committed_count: committed native chains satisfying the unchanged contract
fields.qualified_decoded_count: legacy alias for qualified_committed_count; not total lifecycle completions
fields.metric_receipt_count: mutation receipts only, or null in NATIVE_ONLY
fields.initialization_chains: one per qualified init completion, actual native identity and provenance plus state/source basis; operation_id=null and reason NOT_APPLICABLE_INITIALIZATION
fields.unresolved: Every unproved accepted completion plus critical/identity or population errors

proof.qualified: All equations and bijections hold, unresolved_accepted_count=0, unresolved=[], no critical loss or identity errors. accepted_raw_count>0 -> QUALIFIED; no accepted frames -> NOT_OBSERVED. No new scope-specific metrics receipt for initialization.
proof.legacy: Preserve archived v1 bytes. If v1 remains readable it retains the original strict committed-only meaning, requires its old equality and cannot claim initialization support. New compiler output uses v2; do not relabel a v1 record as v2.
proof.reader_coherence: Update every actual admission consumer of the changed proof fields consistently, especially repair_runner.require_canonical_chain and resume_runner. Old stopped authorities stay closed. No permission to start a new window.

provenance.recorded_vs_compiled: Keep recorded raw/source/SDK/harness identity separate from current compiler/spec identity. Hash-bound archive input/output + compiler identities are mandatory. OFFLINE_REVERIFICATION stays offline and cannot be passed into require_bound_compilation as fresh WORKER_COMPILE.
provenance.archive_preservation: Read archived raw/results/manifests; write derived results to a new result/evidence directory. No source_identity exclusion change.
reuse_conditions: All original runtime/SDK, collector, worker/consumer, corpus, diagnostic toggle, budgets and original run identities remain byte-identical.
Recompiled external/common statistics, final snapshot/terminal/product outcomes, actual accepted record set and all committed canonical receipts/metrics remain equal.
Corrected proof accounts for initialization separately and does not manufacture missing results. Every old run remains independently identified.
The existing diagnostic and overhead cohort remain valid observations eligible for later explicit continuation binding; offline replay is not new sampling or a fresh cohort.
provenance.reuse_verdict: Implementation emits eligible/pending independent review assessment. Control review approves applicability before any future continuation; no overhead cohort rerun is needed solely because an offline decoder changed if the above holds.

explicit_non_goals: Renderer/Brush/Operation/Scene/Skia algorithm or production surface change
Canonical semantic schema or public SDK API change
Browser sampling, artifact rebuilding or reopening r3
Global authority/project-state or historical P34 changes
